critique.evidence: Standard-mode sampling found 0 active animations, 0 transition elements, and 0 changed elements at desktop, tablet, and mobile, so no meaningful motion sequence is demonstrated or judgeable. Timing is stable with a 0 long-frame ratio; tablet/mobile worst frames are about 16.8 ms, while desktop reaches 33.4 ms. Reduced-motion media matches and shows no changed elements, but still reports 1 active animation and transition declarations on every sampled element (99 desktop; 83 tablet/mobile), so reduced-motion implementation is not cleanly proven.
critique.fix: Add and measure purposeful mandate-screen transitions or interaction feedback across multiple frames, then provide longer before/during/after captures. Under prefers-reduced-motion, explicitly disable all animations and transitions so activeAnimationCount and transitionElementCount both reach zero, while preserving the current stable frame pacing.
